title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Modality Interference in Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Causal, perturbation-based diagnostic experiments that inject heuristic noise (e.g., misleading textual descriptions in image-heavy tasks, irrelevant visual content in text-heavy tasks) and adversarial perturbations into task-irrelevant modalities to measure a model's inappropriate reliance on non-essential modalities.
